DOI_ManufacturingExpenseByModel.old:
SELECT @Null_Columns = COALESCE(@Null_Columns, '') + MODEL +'],0) as ['+MODEL+'],coalesce([' 
		FROM (SELECT TOP 500 CONCAT(구분, model) model 
				FROM (
					SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN LEFT(model,2) = N'VN' THEN N'카세트' ELSE 구분 END AS 구분, model   /* [2026-09-16a] 카세트 대분류 */
DOI_ManufacturingExpenseByModel.new:
SELECT @Null_Columns = COALESCE(@Null_Columns, '') + pivot_key +'],0) as ['+col_label+'],coalesce([' 
		FROM (SELECT TOP 500 CONCAT(구분, model) pivot_key, CONCAT(구분, COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT MAX(C.도우코드) FROM doi_cost C WHERE C.yyyymm=@YYYYMM AND C.site=@SITE AND C.구분=A.구분_orig AND C.MODEL=A.model AND C.도우코드<>N'' GROUP BY C.구분,C.MODEL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT C.도우코드)=1), N''), model)) col_label   /* [2026-10-23] 표시 라벨만 도우코드: PIVOT 키=구분+도우모델 불변(@Columns), 출력 별칭만 구분+도우코드(모호/부재시 도우모델 폴백) */
				FROM (
					SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN LEFT(model,2) = N'VN' THEN N'카세트' ELSE 구분 END AS 구분, 구분 AS 구분_orig, model   /* [2026-09-16a] 카세트 대분류 */

DOI_DsitributeMatCostByModel.old:
SELECT @Null_Columns = COALESCE(@Null_Columns, '') + 도우모델 +'],0) as ['+도우모델+'],coalesce([' 
		FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TOP 500 도우모델 from (
				SELECT 도우모델 from DOI_MAT_COST where yyyymm=@YYYYMM and site=@SITE and sel_code = @SEL_CODE
				union all 
				select 'Z합계' 도우모델 
			  ) A
			  ORDER BY 1 )AS models ;
DOI_DsitributeMatCostByModel.new:
SELECT @Null_Columns = COALESCE(@Null_Columns, '') + m.도우모델 +'],0) as ['+ COALESCE(NULLIF(lk.도우코드, N''), m.도우모델) +'],coalesce([' 
		FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TOP 500 도우모델 from (
				SELECT 도우모델 from DOI_MAT_COST where yyyymm=@YYYYMM and site=@SITE and sel_code = @SEL_CODE
				union all 
				select 'Z합계' 도우모델 
			  ) A
			  ORDER BY 1 ) AS m
		LEFT JOIN (
				SELECT MODEL, MAX(도우코드) as 도우코드
				FROM DOI_COST
				WHERE YYYYMM=@YYYYMM AND SITE=@SITE AND 도우코드 <> N''
				GROUP BY MODEL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT 도우코드) = 1
			  ) AS lk ON lk.MODEL = m.도우모델 ;

DOI_SalesAdminByModel.old:
SELECT @Null_Columns = COALESCE(@Null_Columns, '') + MODEL +'],0) as ['+MODEL+'],coalesce([' 
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TOP 500 model 
                FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN LEFT(model,2) = N'VN' THEN N'카세트' ELSE 구분 END+model as model from doi_smce_cost where yyyymm=@YYYYMM and site=@SITE and sel_code=@SEL_CODE
                union all SELECT 'X합계' model union all SELECT 'Y합계' model union all SELECT 'W합계' model union all SELECT 'Z합계' mode
                  )A
                ORDER BY 1 )AS 도우모델 ;
DOI_SalesAdminByModel.new:
SELECT @Null_Columns = COALESCE(@Null_Columns, '') + col_name +'],0) as ['+col_label+'],coalesce([' 
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TOP 500 col_name, col_label 
                FROM (
                SELECT CASE WHEN LEFT(model,2) = N'VN' THEN N'카세트' ELSE 구분 END+model as col_name,
                       CASE WHEN LEFT(model,2) = N'VN' THEN N'카세트' ELSE 구분 END+COALESCE(CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(도우코드)),N''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(도우코드)),N'')) END, model) as col_label
                from doi_smce_cost where yyyymm=@YYYYMM and site=@SITE and sel_code=@SEL_CODE
                group by CASE WHEN LEFT(model,2) = N'VN' THEN N'카세트' ELSE 구분 END, model
                union all SELECT 'X합계','X합계' union all SELECT 'Y합계','Y합계' union all SELECT 'W합계','W합계' union all SELECT 'Z합계','Z합계'
                  )A
                ORDER BY 1 )AS 도우모델 ;
